negative_snippets: I would not recommend this hotel. The reception staff wrongly accused me of a missing blanket during refund processing, and later confirmed it was their mistake. The room was also very small, cleanliness was poor, lights had issues, and the washroom door did not close properly. Overall, a disappointing and unprofessional experience.
